absent: Percpu read acquisition and release full paths beyond the optimistic helper
Plain reader writer semaphore blocking behavior and internal state
Reader regime enter and exit semantics and grace duration
Complete MCS spinlock protocol beyond contended wait and release
Torture control services for thread management, stutter, hotplug, shuffle and shutdown
Dependency tracking and contention tracing contracts and payloads
Exact layouts of torture context, per thread statistics and waiter entries
Priority boost and affinity assignment effects on torture threads

findings.text: A percpu reader writer semaphore offers writer acquisition, writer release and reclamation against a semaphore object. Torture shims for both directions forward to underlying primitives and treat acquisition as infallible.
Mutual exclusion among writers rests on one atomic marker. Observation of a set marker means failure, while a clear marker allows a single claimant to set it atomically and succeed.

Optimistic reader entry uses a CPU local tally plus an ordering fence before sampling the writer marker with acquire semantics. A clear sample means the caller holds read access, while a set sample means the tally is undone locally and the writer wait object is prodded.

Blocked readers and writers serialize through a waiter queue guarded by its spinlock with interrupts masked. Admission rechecks acquisition under that guard, marks entries exclusive with a reader distinction, appends at the tail, then sleeps uninterruptibly until private state observed with acquire semantics indicates wakeup.

Writer acquisition first moves readers toward a slow regime, then secures the exclusion marker with tracing around any wait, and finally remains blocked until no active readers remain. Dependency tracking is acquired at entry and the caller must tolerate sleeping.

Writer release relinquishes dependency tracking, clears the exclusion marker with release semantics, wakes a single waiter when present, and only afterward leaves the reader notification regime. Fast reader entry is therefore unavailable until a later grace interval completes, preserving visibility of the critical section.

Liveness of readers is judged by totaling every possible CPU local tally with a wide accumulator and atomic width enforcement. Zero total plus a subsequent fence means quiescence, otherwise the writer keeps waiting.

The observed semaphore state comprises a pointer to per CPU tallies, a reader regime synchronizer, an atomic exclusion marker, a writer wait object, a waiter collection with its guarding lock, and a dependency map. No other members are visible in these fragments.

A torture operation table couples optional setup and teardown with writer acquire, writer pause, writer release, reader acquire, reader pause, reader release, priority adjustment and a name. The plain reader writer semaphore instance in view lacks setup and teardown, while the percpu instance provides them.

From idle a writer moves to announced, then to marker contention with optional queuing, then to draining active readers, then to held, then back to idle after marker clear, single wakeup and notification exit. Readers that arrive while the marker is set cannot enter the fast regime.

Stress for the percpu variant centers on one static semaphore object shared by all threads. Setup must succeed and teardown releases resources, coordinated through the operation table lifecycle hooks.

Thin shims adapt plain and percpu primitives to a uniform torture signature that accepts a thread number and ignores it. Read release for the plain variant delegates to the underlying read release, and percpu shims delegate in both directions.

Hold time while reading is usually brief but sporadically extended by configuration, with an additional rare chance of yielding the processor. The extended case is intended to provoke severe rivalry among readers.

Module startup chooses one operation table by textual name, derives default thread counts from online CPU count when requested values are negative, prepares statistics and auxiliary services, launches interleaved writers and readers plus an optional reporter, and funnels every failure through shared teardown. Teardown leaves no threads, no statistics storage and no affinity allocations, with operation exit invoked at most once.

Writer and reader threads run until a stop indication, each iteration optionally yielding, adjusting priority, handling optional nesting, acquiring the selected lock, accounting success, pausing while holding, updating held indicators, releasing, and honoring a global stutter gate. Writers may bypass the central lock at a low rate when nesting is enabled and warn once when acquisition latency exceeds a configured bound.

Correctness monitoring uses a writer held flag and a reader held tally. Any observed overlap between exclusive holding and shared holding counts as a failure for the observing thread, without altering lock behavior.

Reporting aggregates per thread acquisition counts and failure flags for one direction, computing total, extremes and a global error increment on any failure. Output is a single summary line carrying imbalance and failure markers, produced on a periodic schedule and once more after the reporter stops.

Configuration logging emits one alert record with a caller supplied tag, the selected torture identity, numeric tunables, affinity masks that default to full coverage, and a debug indication when lock debugging is active for the chosen family.

An auxiliary chain keeps grace activity alive by rearming through callback and poll mechanisms while a stop indicator remains clear. Shutdown publishes the stop indicator, waits for barrier completion, then reclaims the chain storage and clears the global reference.

Reclamation is safe against a zero filled object by treating an absent per CPU tally pointer as already freed. Otherwise it destroys notification state, frees per CPU storage and nulls the pointer so later misuse is detectable.

Correct pairing of tally increment and decrement on the same processor depends on controlling preemption across the optimistic attempt. Either side missing the peer update is still safe because the fence after increment pairs with the fence after observing quiescence.
Writer acquisition can block and waiter sleep is uninterruptible, so these paths require a sleepable context and are immune to signal interruption. Reader optimistic attempt itself does not block.
Statistics printing sizes its temporary buffer from active thread counts and tolerates allocation failure by logging and returning without emitting a report.
Contended MCS unlock is a release store of one to the lock word, while contended MCS lock waits with acquire semantics until that value appears.
The MCS spinlock header defines a multiple inclusion guard macro.
The two operation tables observed here carry distinct textual identities, one denoting plain semaphore stress and the other denoting percpu semaphore stress.
